evidence.note: Wide lower drawer to the left of the stove is fully closed.
User is pulling the drawer outward; it is already partly open.
Drawer is fully extended with contents visible.
User is pushing the still-open drawer inward.
Drawer is fully closed again.

events.object_description: Wide upper drawer in the white base cabinet immediately left of the stove

evidence.note: User reaches for the left door of the double upper cabinet above the stove.
Left cabinet door is visibly swung open, exposing the cabinet interior.
Both cabinet doors remain visibly open.
User is manipulating the doors during the closing sequence.
All upper wood cabinet doors are closed.

events.object_description: Left door of the double upper cabinet above the stove/range hood

evidence.note: Left cabinet door is open while the right door remains closed.
User reaches to and begins moving the right cabinet door.
Right cabinet door is now swung outward; both doors are open.
Right door remains visibly open.
Door-closing manipulation is underway.
Right cabinet door is closed with the rest of the cabinet front.

events.object_description: Right door of the double upper cabinet above the stove/range hood

evidence.note: Upper drawer in the narrow cabinet right of the stove is closed as the user reaches for its handle.
Drawer has been pulled substantially open and its contents are visible.
Drawer remains open immediately before the closing action.
User is finishing pushing the drawer shut; the front is nearly flush.
Drawer is fully closed and the user has withdrawn.

events.object_description: Upper drawer in the white base cabinet immediately right of the stove, beneath the air fryer

notes: Four distinct movable-part episodes are visible. The two upper-cabinet doors are counted separately because each is a distinct door and their opening transitions occur sequentially. Their individual closing order is not clearly resolved within the sampling interval, so both off transitions are estimated near frame 556.
scene_description: A user surveys a narrow modern kitchen, then opens and closes a food-storage drawer left of the stove, separately opens and closes both doors of the upper cabinet above the stove, and finally opens and closes a utensil/foil drawer right of the stove.
